howItWorksIntro: Welcome to "Who is Right?" — a funny little corner of the internet where people can settle friendly debates with the help of a totally unbiased, highly questionable… AI judge 🧑‍⚖️🤖
step1Description: At the top, type the argument or situation you're both "definitely right" about.
step2Description: Each of you gets your own input to tell your side of the story. Be honest… or at least entertaining!
step3Description: Hit the magical "Who is right?" button and let the AI give its (often absurd) verdict.
disclaimerText: This app is meant for entertainment only. All answers are generated by AI and should never be taken seriously, legally, medically, romantically, or in any real-world way.
disclaimerPoint1: The AI does not know the truth, nor does it pretend to.
disclaimerPoint2: Never share sensitive, personal, or confidential information.
dataPrivacy: Your inputs are temporarily saved so our developers can monitor for abuse and improve safety. Data is not shared, not stored long-term, and never used for AI training. This is for security and moderation purposes only.
finalMessage: Have fun, don't fight too hard, and remember — the AI is always wrong… or right… or whatever it feels like today!
